note: All values are ASSUMED model inputs for a fictional courier (DubaiDash Express), not statistics. Owner: Advait. Keep in sync with docs/06_assumptions_table.md.

fallback.label: Haversine x detour factor (used only if OSRM is unreachable)
fallback.note_bike: Bikes feel traffic multipliers at 60% strength (assumed)

shifts.note: Two-shift model: half of each vehicle type starts 08:00, half 11:00; duty ends start + max_duty_min

fuel.note: van = diesel, bike = petrol (assumed fuel types)

provenance._note: One row per value: status (assumed unless sourced), one-line reason, plausible range. Shown in the Assumptions drawer.

seed.reason: fixed seed so baseline, AI, slides and demo use identical orders

vehicles.van.count.reason: mid-size courier fleet for about 300 parcels a day

vehicles.bike.count.reason: motorbikes are common for small parcels in Dubai

vehicles.van.capacity_parcels.reason: small panel van, mixed parcel sizes

vehicles.bike.cost_per_km_aed.reason: lower fuel and upkeep than a van

vehicles.van.co2_kg_per_km.reason: typical light diesel van tailpipe; replace with a cited factor if time

vehicles.van.co2_kg_per_km_electric.reason: electric van on a grid mix (indirect emissions)

vehicles.bike.co2_kg_per_km_electric.reason: electric motorbike on a grid mix

vehicles.van.max_duty_min.reason: 9 h duty inside the 08:00 to 20:00 operating window

orders.count.reason: one demo day for a mid-size courier

orders.cod_share.reason: cash on delivery is still used in the UAE

orders.urgent_surge_orders.reason: what-if surge size for the re-routing demo

costs.driver_cost_per_hour_aed.reason: loaded hourly driver cost (salary, visa, housing share)

costs.sla_penalty_aed.reason: voucher or goodwill cost of a missed window

failed_attempt.base_probability.reason: industry sources report a wide 8 to 20% range (R3, indicative only)

failed_attempt.sandstorm_extra.reason: customers stay in, access is harder

failed_attempt.late_extra.reason: customer may have left after the window

failed_attempt.cod_extra.reason: cash not ready or order refused

failed_attempt.tight_window_extra.reason: less room to retry inside a 1-hour slot

sla.risk_buffer_min.reason: dispatcher wants 15 min warning before a window closes

fuel.co2_kg_per_litre.van.reason: standard diesel combustion factor, used only to show litres

fuel.co2_kg_per_litre.bike.reason: standard petrol combustion factor, used only to show litres

traffic_hour_multipliers.reason: morning and evening peaks on free-flow time

event_multipliers.sheikh_zayed_road_jam.reason: what-if corridor jam, not a live feed

event_multipliers.al_khail_road_jam.reason: what-if corridor jam, not a live feed

event_multipliers.heavy_rain_citywide.reason: what-if rain, slower driving and flooding

fallback.haversine_detour_factor.reason: straight line to road distance in a grid city

fallback.bike_traffic_sensitivity.reason: bikes filter through traffic and feel 60% of jams

business_case.adoption_haircut.reason: real savings are lower than simulation

shifts.early_start.reason: two-shift model, half of each vehicle type

shifts.late_start.reason: second wave covers the evening peak
